Good morning, everyone. Thanks for coming. It's a cold one, isn't it? Right, here is how today works. There are six heats, and every heat is twenty minutes. Check the heat sheet for your number and your jersey color. When you hear the horn, the heat starts. When you hear the horn again, it's over, so come in. You can catch as many waves as you want, but only your best two waves count for your score. I'm looking for good waves, not a lot of waves. After the heats, I pick four surfers for the squad and one reserve. The names come out on Monday, on your club group. Not today, so please don't ask me on the beach. Okay. Heat one, you're in the water in five minutes. Good luck.

Mate, it's Kai. That heat was crazy, wasn't it? The waves went flat for ten minutes and then, boom, a set. You got the best wave of the heat, didn't you? The aerial at the end! I saw Dana writing something on her clipboard, and she smiled. She doesn't smile much, does she? Your score was a seven and a half on that one, I think. Harper got an eight, of course. Anyway, you surfed really well, and you were calm, weren't you? Not like last month. I can't tell you anything about the squad until Monday. You know that, don't you? So stop checking your phone. Go eat something. See you at the kiosk.
